_readme: Data for the sales map on reviews.html. Made by scripts/import_etsy_orders.py from Etsy order CSVs (kept out of the repo in private/etsy-orders/); rebuild the page with python3 scripts/build_shop.py. Only town or city, region, country, rounded coordinates and an order count per place: never names, addresses, ZIP codes, order IDs or money. A place with lat/lon null is counted but not drawn; type its coordinates in by hand and later imports keep them.
